title: Ultrasound-assisted synthesis of biomass-derived carbon-supported binary metal oxides for efficient adsorption of heavy metals from wastewater
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,13662-13680
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00057B, Paper
Open Access

Walaa S. Gado, Asmaa S. Morshedy, Ahmed M. Masoud, Ard elshifa M. E. Mohammed, Entsar H. Taha, Adel A. El-Zahhar, Majed M. Alghamdi, Ahmed M. A. El Naggar, Esraa M. El-Fawal
An innovative composite structure is prepared via coupling of a new bio-char structure generated from sunflower residues with particles of binary metal oxides. This composite could efficiently purify wastewater by removing both Zn and Cd ions.
